manuscript_claims.text: The tai chi trial randomized 120 participants.
Participants in the tai chi trial had a mean age of 71.4 years.
Tai chi reduced depressive symptoms by 40 percent.
Tai chi did not change depressive symptoms compared with usual care.
Depressive symptoms fell more with tai chi than with usual care.
